prompt: Composition: Single reading column, left aligned headings, marginal metadata, thin section rules. Build for this brief: A cultural venue; visitors browse works, plan visits and find events. Set headings in Cooper Hewitt and reading text in Inter; architectural sans heading with neutral interface text. Use Spectrum 1-9: page #FBFAF9, text #2D2D1F, accent #42861D, secondary surface #E7EEEF, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 16px, heading 48px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 40ch, gap 24px, content width at most 960px and item radius 0px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
